hook: Your spaceship used to ride piggyback on a jet.
title: Your Spaceship Rode Piggyback On A Jumbo Jet
description:
NASA really carried the space shuttle orbiter on top of a modified Boeing 747 called the Shuttle Carrier Aircraft. It flew shuttles across the US, and one still sits on top of its jet in Houston. Series: Wait, What? Space.

#Shorts #Space #NASA
comment_prompt: Would you fly under a shuttle? Yes or no
